name: Azure Blob Storage Backend
description: Stores the state as a Blob with the given Key within the Blob Container within the Azure Blob Storage Account. This backend supports state locking and consistency checking with Azure Blob Storage native capabilities.

attributes.name: storage_account_name
attributes.description: The name of the Azure Storage Account where the state file will be stored.

attributes.name: container_name
attributes.description: The name of the Storage Container within the Storage Account where the state blob will be stored.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: The name of the Blob used to retrieve/store Terraform's State file inside the Storage Container.

attributes.name: environment
attributes.description: The Azure Environment which should be used. Defaults to 'public'.

attributes.name: metadata_host
attributes.description: The Hostname of the Azure Metadata Service (for example management.azure.com), used to obtain the Cloud Environment when using a Custom Azure Environment.

attributes.name: lookup_blob_endpoint
attributes.description: Set to true to look up the Storage Account Data Plane URI from the Management Plane. Required if using the 'Azure DNS zone endpoints' feature. Defaults to false.

attributes.name: snapshot
attributes.description: Set to true to snapshot the Blob used to store the Terraform state file before use. Defaults to false.

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: The Tenant ID of the Microsoft Entra ID principal. Required when using service principal authentication (with client_secret or client_certificate_path), OIDC authentication (use_oidc), and optionally with Azure AD authentication (use_azuread_auth). Can also be set via ARM_TENANT_ID environment variable.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: The Subscription ID of the storage account. Required for management plane authentication when using lookup_blob_endpoint or Access Key Lookup method. Can also be set via ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable.

attributes.name: resource_group_name
attributes.description: The Name of the Resource Group in which the Storage Account exists. Required for management plane authentication when using lookup_blob_endpoint or Access Key Lookup method.

attributes.name: use_azuread_auth
attributes.description: Set to true to use Microsoft Entra ID authentication for storage account data plane authentication. This is the recommended authentication method. Can also be set via ARM_USE_AZUREAD environment variable.

attributes.name: use_cli
attributes.description: Set to true to use the Azure CLI session for authentication to the storage account management and data plane. Requires a pre-authenticated Azure CLI session. Can also be set via ARM_USE_CLI environment variable.

attributes.name: use_oidc
attributes.description: Set to true to use OpenID Connect / Workload identity federation for authentication. This is the recommended method for CI/CD pipelines. Can also be set via ARM_USE_OIDC environment variable.

attributes.name: use_msi
attributes.description: Set to true to use a Compute Attached Managed Service Identity for authentication. Can also be set via ARM_USE_MSI environment variable.

attributes.name: use_aks_workload_identity
attributes.description: Set to true to use Azure AKS Workload Identity for authentication. Can also be set via ARM_USE_AKS_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY environment variable.

attributes.name: access_key
attributes.description: The Access Key used to authenticate to the storage account data plane. Not recommended for new workloads - use Microsoft Entra ID authentication instead. Can also be set via ARM_ACCESS_KEY environment variable.

attributes.name: sas_token
attributes.description: The SAS Token used to authenticate to the storage account data plane. Not recommended for new workloads - use Microsoft Entra ID authentication instead. Can also be set via ARM_SAS_TOKEN environment variable.

attributes.name: client_id
attributes.description: The Client ID of the Microsoft Entra ID Service Principal, App Registration, or User Assigned Managed Identity. Required for OIDC, Client Secret, and Client Certificate authentication methods. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

attributes.name: client_id_file_path
attributes.description: The path to a file containing the Client ID. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_ID_FILE_PATH environment variable.

attributes.name: client_secret
attributes.description: The Client Secret of the Service Principal. Not recommended - use OIDC or Managed Identity instead. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.

attributes.name: client_secret_file_path
attributes.description: The path to a file containing the Client Secret. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE_PATH environment variable.

attributes.name: client_certificate_path
attributes.description: The path to the PFX file used as the Client Certificate when authenticating as a Service Principal. Not recommended - use OIDC or Managed Identity instead. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH environment variable.

attributes.name: client_certificate_password
attributes.description: The password associated with the Client Certificate specified in client_certificate_path. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD environment variable.

attributes.name: client_certificate
attributes.description: Base64 encoded PKCS#12 certificate bundle to use when authenticating as a Service Principal using a Client Certificate. Can also be set via ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE environment variable.

attributes.name: msi_endpoint
attributes.description: The path to a custom Managed Service Identity endpoint which is automatically determined if not specified. Can also be set via ARM_MSI_ENDPOINT environment variable.

attributes.name: oidc_request_url
attributes.description: The URL for the Open ID Connect provider from which to request an ID token. Only required for advanced scenarios or third party integrations. Can also be set via ARM_OIDC_REQUEST_URL, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL, or SYSTEM_OIDCREQUESTURI environment variables.

attributes.name: oidc_request_token
attributes.description: The bearer token for the request to the Open ID Connect provider. Only required for advanced scenarios or third party integrations. Can also be set via ARM_OIDC_REQUEST_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, or SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN environment variables.

attributes.name: oidc_token
attributes.description: The ID Token when authenticating using OpenID Connect. Only required for advanced scenarios or third party integrations. Can also be set via ARM_OIDC_TOKEN environment variable.

attributes.name: oidc_token_file_path
attributes.description: The path to a file containing an ID token when authenticating using OpenID Connect. Can also be set via ARM_OIDC_TOKEN_FILE_PATH environment variable.

attributes.name: ado_pipeline_service_connection_id
attributes.description: The Azure DevOps Pipeline Service Connection ID required for OIDC authentication with Azure DevOps. Can also be set via ARM_ADO_PIPELINE_SERVICE_CONNECTION_ID or ARM_OIDC_AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION_ID environment variables.
